Initial release of go-tinker, an unofficial typed Go client for the Thinking Machines Tinker API.

- Provides generated, strongly-typed clients for all 15 endpoints of the Tinker training API using oapi-codegen.
- Supports secure authentication via `X-API-Key` header from the `TINKER_API_KEY` environment variable.
- Guides proper usage, with examples for model training, sampling, and handling async futures.
- Details best practices for security, error handling, and when (or not) to use this package.
- Ready for Go projects needing to interact with the Tinker API via `github.com/psyb0t/go-tinker`.
